I will determine whether this text is an invoice and then extract the required fields without guessing missing values.

1) Document classification (invoice vs non-invoice)

No prominent exclusion headers like "Zahlungserinnerung" or "Mahnung" are present. Therefore classify as invoice(s).
- There are multiple invoice-like documents consolidated (several FACTURA sections and CFDI blocks). The schema expects single fields; follow rule: if multiple occurrences, return each occurrence in same structure—however given schema fields are single-valued (but allow Vat.Item array). The schema comment: "Important: Vat.Item is an array" — but provided schema properties are flat: Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount. Developer note says treat them as entries in Vat.Item Array. So I will populate Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount as arrays (but schema types are number or ""). Still follow instruction: include multiple VAT group entries.

2) Identify candidate invoice to use for GrandTotal.Amount and Invoice.Date
- Several totals appear:

Also earlier "Total Servicios CFDI : 1,183.20" and "Total Ingresos : 1,020.00" and IVA 163.20; but overall invoice total 7,498.78 seems final.
  - Associated emission date on that block: "Fecha Emisión : 15/12/2022 10:27:01" (Page 1 top).
- Other invoices (ALTAMIRA TERMINAL etc.) have totals: 2,064.80 (page2), 56.78 (page4), 190.00 (page5), 3,726.00 (page6). Those are separate supplier invoices (D-PINFRA). But the main consolidated invoice from LOGISTICA ADUANAL shows Grand Total 7,498.78. Given schema expects one GrandTotal.Amount and one Invoice.Date, use the main document's total and date.

3) Extract GrandTotal.Amount
- On Page 1: "Total Factura (GXT + CFDI) : 7,498.78" and "Saldo CFDI : 7,498.78". No currency symbol required in output; field type number. So GrandTotal.Amount = 7498.78.

4) Extract Invoice.Date
- Use the Emisor block "Fecha Emisión : 15/12/2022 10:27:01". The schema expects a string. Use full datetime as seen: "15/12/2022 10:27:01".

5) Extract Sender.VatId
- On Page 1 Emisor RFC is "LAJ160818355". That is the sender VAT ID. Use exactly "LAJ160818355".

6) Extract VAT groups (Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount)
- The invoice displays VAT groups for the LOGISTICA ADUANAL main invoice:
  - In Conceptos area: two line items show IVA 16% applied: line totals show amounts and IVA base per line. Then summary lines:
    - "Total Ingresos : 1,020.00" and "I.V.A. 16 % : 163.20" and "Total Servicios CFDI : 1,183.20". That suggests one VAT group at 16% with Net = 1,020.00 and Vat = 163.20.
  - Additionally, "Desglose de Gastos por Cuenta de Terceros" totals 6,315.58 and combined total 7,498.78. The third-party expenses likely not subject to VAT in this invoice (they are separate supplier invoices including IVA). But schema expects Vat.Item entries only for the invoice-level VAT groups. I see only VAT group: 16% net 1,020.00 vat 163.20.
- There may be VAT=0 groups for services taxed at 0% (page6 has IVA 0.00 for 3,726.00), but that is an external supplier invoice (INFRAESTRUCTURA) included in third-party expenses; the developer rule 6: "Only exchange rates applicable to the entire invoice..." irrelevant. Rule 1: If multiple occurrences of a detail exist (e.g., Line.Item and BankAccount.Item), return each occurrence. But for Vat.Item they want multiple entries if present. For main invoice, only 16% appears. So set Vat.Rate = [16], Net.Amount = [1020.00], Vat.Amount = [163.20].
- Ensure rates are numbers without percent symbol and preserve decimal places as in input. Input shows 163.20 with two decimals — preserve.

7) Net.Amount and Vat.Amount types: numbers. Net.Amount = 1020.00, Vat.Amount = 163.20, Vat.Rate = 16.

8) Check No Inference policy: I will not infer currency or other VAT groups. If any field missing, leave empty; but all required fields have values found.

- Invoice.Date: "15/12/2022 10:27:01"

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High
- Evidence: Page 1 lists "I.V.A. 16 % : 163.20" directly. Matches calculation from Net.Amount and Vat.Rate.

- Multiple embedded supplier invoices (pages 2–6) contain other totals/VAT lines (e.g., 0% group or separate IVA amounts), but the main consolidated invoice on Page 1 explicitly summarizes invoice-level net and IVA; thus fields were taken from that primary block. Confidence reflects that choice.
